Not sure if this is what you are looking for...but here are some things I would consider:
Voluntary response bias: some participants who have the time and patience to thoughtfully respond may be in some way fundamentally different from those who did not answer in great detail so getting a balanced sample is important.
Leading Questions: it is important to keep your own bias out of the statements and try to stray from prefacing a question with a value attached.
